svg.title: Every B. subtilis 168 OD600 run on BR-01, June to September 2026
svg.desc: Four panels. Run 1 and run 2: hand-sampled OD600 in the reactor against a shake flask. Run 3: 434 hours of in-line OD600 at 22 °C. Run 4: in-line OD600 in two logged parts with a 10-hour gap.
svg.text: Hand-sampled; stopped by a leak at the pump
In-line photometer, no sample drawn, 434 h
Run 4 · 1 to 6 September, 168 + constitutive ACCD, full module
In-line photometer, two logged files, 10 h unrecorded
Lines: hourly medians of the in-line reading (half-hourly in run 4's first file). Panels have their own axes; run 1 and 2 are hand samples.
